configuration.title: LLS CCAI
configuration.autoReloadWindow.descripti: Automatically reload the window after switching the current Claude Code model.
configuration.language.description: Display language for the LLS CCAI settings UI. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
When enabled, one-click writing Claude Code settings will set initialPermissionMode=bypassPermissions and allowDangerouslySkipPermissions=true. Use only in trusted sandbox environments.
configuration.taskFlow.target.descriptio: Where task-flow prompts are sent. externalClaudeCode keeps the legacy clipboard/focus path; builtinChat sends directly to the built-in Chat when its CLI is available.
configuration.chat.enabled.description: Enable the built-in Chat Webview backed by the local Claude CLI. Disabled by default while the Chat migration is in progress.
configuration.chat.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the Claude-compatible CLI executable used by the built-in Chat Webview.
configuration.chat.cliArgs.description: Additional arguments appended when launching the Claude CLI for the built-in Chat Webview.
configuration.chat.cliCwd.description: Working directory for the Claude CLI. Defaults to the active workspace folder when empty.
configuration.chat.transport.description: CLI transport for the built-in Chat Webview. streamJsonStdio is the default long-running bidirectional stream-json mode; printStdio is a single-shot fallback; pty is experimental.
configuration.chat.cliEnv.description: Extra environment variables used when launching the Claude CLI. Avoid storing tokens or other secrets here.
configuration.chat.permissionMode.descri: Claude CLI permission mode passed via --permission-mode. Defaults to acceptEdits so that Edit/Write/Read tools are auto-approved in non-interactive --bare --print mode. Use 'default' to keep CLI's prompts (which may block silently), or 'bypassPermissions' to skip all checks (sandbox only).
configuration.chat.currentModel.descript: Current model used by the built-in Chat. Workspace value takes precedence over global value and is passed to Claude CLI with --model.
configuration.openapicopilot.systemPromp: System prompt shared with LLS OAI / openapi-compatible-copilot.
